Great seafood lunch at My Khe Beach in Nha Trang
Dec 2018 • Family
There are many places to eat a seafood lunch at My Khe. We arrived late (around 1 pm) and walked up the road, enjoying the salty breeze and the sight and sound of waves crashing on the beach the other side of the road. We picked 27 as we noticed other people eating a late lunch and were glad we did. The menu is lengthy and covers seafood you’ve probably never heard of as well as familiar favourites such as tiger prawns. We chose crab - a smallish crab called flowering crab that I hadn’t seen before - with tamarind sauce and grilled tiger prawns. The prawns arrived first but were duly whisked off the table to be carefully peeled - a special favour I think for our table. The crab then arrived and they cracked the main claws for us before returning it. All the seafood was delicious, and the tamarind sauce was one of the nicest we’d eaten. We were offered crispy fresh Bahn mi to mop up the sauce. A lovely casual lunch.

The staff are so nice
Aug 2018 • Couples
This is a sad review. How can anyone take the freshest seafood and turn it into something inedible then charge extortionately high prices while the waiting staff make apologies? 1.5 million VND for clams, eight prawns, two small tiger beers and an apple tea. This is capitalism at its worst in a developing communist country, absolutely no consideration to quality over profit. I had also ordered fresh BBQ fish, if I had given the same fish to a five year old child to play with for two weeks it would have been more palatable than what arrived on my plate. With respect to the restaurant, they didn't charge me for the small mouthful I endeavored to consume.
